x: Archie Bedford ran his usual "gutty" race and passed the Aylesford man putting Jack Brown off second 50 seconds behind Laurie Reed S.L.H. junior.

Ray was therefore forced to give ground, although retaining his fourth place, and at Lowfield Heath we were 2 min.12 sec. behind S.L.H., who had gone into the lead through a good run by Laurie Reed, 2 min.6 sec. behind Sheffield and 2 min.1 sec. down on T.V.H.

Not only was he the 5th consecutive Belgravian to do fastest time---a time shared by Laurie Reed of S.L.H. running some eight minutes behind,-but he opened up our lead to almost 3 minutes to put us out in front in gay isolation.

His dedication paid off and his 1957/58 achievements were crowned by a superb victory (by over a minute) in the National Junior C.C.Championship at Parliament Hill when he shattered a class field which included the likes of Laurie Reed, Stan Eldon, John Merriman and Don Taylor.
